' SPDX-License-Identifier: CC-BY-SA-4.0
Private Function GroupShapeVector(ByVal s As Object) As String
    Dim child As Object, result As String
    result = s.ID & "," & s.Name & "," & s.Type & "," & s.ZOrderPosition
    If s.Type = 6 Then
        result = result & "["
        For Each child In s.GroupItems
            result = result & GroupShapeVector(child) & ";"
        Next
        result = result & "]"
    End If
    GroupShapeVector = result
End Function

Private Function GroupLayerVector(ByVal ws As Object) As String
    Dim s As Object, o As Object, n As Object, result As String
    result = "Shapes#"
    For Each s In ws.Shapes
        result = result & GroupShapeVector(s) & ";"
    Next
    result = result & "OLE#"
    For Each o In ws.OLEObjects
        result = result & GroupShapeVector(o.ShapeRange) & ";"
    Next
    result = result & "Notes#"
    For Each n In ws.Comments
        result = result & GroupShapeVector(n.Shape) & ";"
    Next
    GroupLayerVector = result
End Function

Public Function Probe(ByVal mode As Long) As String
    Dim wb As Object, ws As Object, rectangle As Object, inner As Object
    Dim group As Object, note As Object, target As Object
    Dim names As Variant, i As Long, before As String, hot As String
    Set wb = Workbooks.Open("C:\work\provider.xlsx", 0, True)
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    names = Array("Back", "Left", "Middle", "Right", "Front")
    For i = 0 To 4
        Set rectangle = ws.Shapes.AddShape(1, 10 + 30 * i, 10, 20, 20)
        rectangle.Name = names(i)
    Next
    If mode \ 8 = 2 Then
        Set inner = ws.Shapes.Range(Array("Left", "Middle")).Group
        inner.Name = "Pair"
        Set group = ws.Shapes.Range(Array("Pair", "Right")).Group
    Else
        Set group = ws.Shapes.Range(Array("Left", "Middle", "Right")).Group
    End If
    group.Name = "Bundle"
    If mode \ 8 > 0 Then Set note = ws.Range("D2").AddComment("group layer note")
    before = GroupLayerVector(ws)
    wb.SaveAs "C:\work\mixed-source.xlsx", 51
    If (mode \ 4) Mod 2 = 0 Then
        Set target = group
    Else
        Set target = group.GroupItems(1)
    End If
    target.ZOrder mode Mod 4
    hot = GroupLayerVector(ws)
    wb.SaveAs "C:\work\mixed-copy.xlsx", 51
    wb.Close False
    Set wb = Workbooks.Open("C:\work\mixed-copy.xlsx", 0, True)
    Probe = before & "@" & hot & "@" & GroupLayerVector(wb.Worksheets(1))
    wb.Close False
End Function

' SPDX-License-Identifier: CC-BY-SA-4.0
Private Function ParentView(ByVal s As Object) As String
    Dim name As String, number As Long, description As String
    On Error Resume Next
    Err.Clear
    name = s.ParentGroup.Name
    number = Err.Number
    description = Err.Description
    On Error GoTo 0
    If number = 0 Then
        ParentView = "V:" & name
    Else
        ParentView = "E:" & number & ":" & description
    End If
End Function

Private Function ShapeView(ByVal s As Object) As String
    Dim result As String
    result = s.Name & "," & s.ID & "," & s.Type & "," & s.ZOrderPosition & "," & s.Child
    result = result & "," & ParentView(s)
    If s.Type = 6 Then result = result & "," & s.GroupItems.Count
    ShapeView = result
End Function

Private Function LookupView(ByVal owner As Object, ByVal name As String, ByVal grouped As Boolean) As String
    Dim s As Object, number As Long, description As String
    On Error Resume Next
    Err.Clear
    If grouped Then
        Set s = owner.GroupItems(name)
    Else
        Set s = owner.Shapes(name)
    End If
    number = Err.Number
    description = Err.Description
    On Error GoTo 0
    If number = 0 Then
        LookupView = "V:" & ShapeView(s)
    Else
        LookupView = "E:" & number & ":" & description
    End If
End Function

Private Function GroupView(ByVal ws As Object) As String
    Dim group As Object, item As Object, name As Variant, result As String
    Set group = ws.Shapes("Bundle")
    result = "Count=" & ws.Shapes.Count & "#Root=" & ShapeView(group) & "#Items="
    For Each item In group.GroupItems
        result = result & ShapeView(item) & ";"
    Next
    result = result & "#Lookups="
    For Each name In Array("Left", "Middle", "Right", "Pair", "Bundle")
        result = result & name & "[" & LookupView(ws, CStr(name), False) & "][" & LookupView(group, CStr(name), True) & "];"
    Next
    GroupView = result
End Function

Public Function Probe(ByVal mode As Long) As String
    Dim wb As Object, ws As Object, rectangle As Object, inner As Object, group As Object
    Dim note As Object, names As Variant, i As Long, before As String
    Set wb = Workbooks.Open("C:\work\provider.xlsx", 0, True)
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    names = Array("Back", "Left", "Middle", "Right", "Front")
    For i = 0 To 4
        Set rectangle = ws.Shapes.AddShape(1, 10 + 30 * i, 10, 20, 20)
        rectangle.Name = names(i)
    Next
    If mode = 2 Then
        Set inner = ws.Shapes.Range(Array("Left", "Middle")).Group
        inner.Name = "Pair"
        Set group = ws.Shapes.Range(Array("Pair", "Right")).Group
    Else
        Set group = ws.Shapes.Range(Array("Left", "Middle", "Right")).Group
    End If
    group.Name = "Bundle"
    If mode > 0 Then Set note = ws.Range("D2").AddComment("group layer note")
    before = GroupView(ws)
    wb.SaveAs "C:\work\mixed-source.xlsx", 51
    wb.Close False
    Set wb = Workbooks.Open("C:\work\mixed-source.xlsx", 0, True)
    Probe = before & "@" & GroupView(wb.Worksheets(1))
    wb.SaveCopyAs "C:\work\mixed-copy.xlsx"
    wb.Close False
End Function

Option Explicit
Public Function ShapeView(ByVal s As Object) As Variant
    Dim children As Variant, parts() As Variant, i As Long
    children = Array()
    If s.Type = 6 Then
        ReDim parts(0 To s.GroupItems.Count - 1)
        For i = 1 To s.GroupItems.Count
            parts(i - 1) = ShapeView(s.GroupItems(i))
        Next i
        children = parts
    End If
    ShapeView = Array(CLng(s.ID), CStr(s.Name), CLng(s.Type), CLng(s.ZOrderPosition), CLng(s.Child), CLng(s.Placement), CDbl(s.Left), CDbl(s.Top), CDbl(s.Width), CDbl(s.Height), CDbl(s.Rotation), children)
End Function

    Dim parts() As Variant, i As Long
    If ws.Shapes.Count = 0 Then

        ReDim parts(0 To ws.Shapes.Count - 1)
        For i = 1 To ws.Shapes.Count

    End If

Public Function Probe(ByVal mode As Long) As Variant

    Set b = Workbooks.Open("C:\work\provider.xlsx")

    Select Case mode

    b.Close False
